author: bardic-inspiration
name: Burrowing Cadaver
summary: A grave-dirt-caked corpse that tunnels beneath the earth and drags the living down.
description: Where graveyards sit above old drains and root-cellars, cadavers dig between them in the night. A shuffle of loose soil is the only warning before a hand closes around an ankle.

understood: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.text: The cadaver can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and loose soil without disturbing the material it moves through.

actions.name: Grasping Claw
actions.onHit: The target has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc:str}). Until this grapple ends, the cadaver can't make Grasping Claw attacks against a different target.

actions.name: Pull Under
actions.text: One creature Grappled by the cadaver takes {dmg:2d6+str:bludgeoning} as the cadaver burrows 10 feet, dragging the creature with it. The creature ends up in an unoccupied space the cadaver chooses within 5 feet of it, beneath the surface, and has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition there until the grapple ends.
